Contextual grounding check scores 0-1 and blocks responses below the grounding threshold; raising it makes the check stricter against ungrounded RAG answers. Key correct.
Prompt-attack filter detects injection at input and least-privilege scoping of action-group tools/IAM limits blast radius if one slips through, giving true defense in depth. Key correct.

Bedrock by default does not train base models on customer prompts/completions nor share with providers; keeping invocation logging off avoids persistence, and ZDR covers residual retention. Least-overhead and correct.
